info.title: BoomScrolling account API
info.description: Account-scoped REST/MCP operations, including separately scoped immediate owner originals. Scoped product OAuth or managed Sites identity. Writer access, review consent, provider funding and posting remain separate.

x-sites-authentication.description: The existing Sites session authenticates browser requests. Raw identity headers are not a public credential.

x-agent-authentication.description: The same scoped product token authenticates canonical /agent/mcp and /api/v1/ REST. New optional permissions require reviewed consent; refresh cannot expand them.

get.description: Read current workspace access and provider allowance without a provider call. Sign-in, product access, X permission and funding are separate. No purchase links or private owner data.
